title: PeakMC
body:
### Welcome to PeakMC...


**PeakMC** is an **immersive, optimized, and fresh** modpack that adds lots of new content such as **new structures, mobs, biomes, improved textures & models for various mobs, new items, 3d items, & an improved ender dragon fight that makes this modpack feel _unique_!**

**NOTE: It is recomended not to change the order of the resource packs as it   _may_   break them.**

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## FAQ

Q: Can I play this with my friends?


**A: Yes, but you would need to load the modpack onto the server. Modrinth servers are recommended with their quick and easy modpack loaders.**




Q: Where do I report bugs?

**A: You can report bugs on either my discord server or my youtube channel!**

Q: Is this compatible with [_insert mod here_}?

**A: Not all mods are compatabile with the PeakMC modpack; it is up to you to test out which mods work. However, if you want a certain mod or resource pack to be added, let me know in my discord server!**
